findings.narrative: The deterministic billing engine confirms that line item line-api-calls was overcharged. The original bill was 5000¢ for 500 units, but usage telemetry records show 250 production units and 150 staging units. Contract rules specify that staging environments are exempt. Recalculating based on the 250 production units at 10¢ per unit results in a correct charge of 2500¢, indicating an overcharge of 2500¢.
findings.raw_ai_text: The deterministic billing engine confirms that line item line-api-calls was overcharged. The original bill was 5000¢ for 500 units, but usage telemetry records show 250 production units and 150 staging units. Contract rules specify that staging environments are exempt. Recalculating based on the 250 production units at 10¢ per unit results in a correct charge of 2500¢, indicating an overcharge of 2500¢.
verified_facts: Invoice line line-api-calls was originally billed 5000¢.
Usage telemetry recorded 250.0 production units under event ev-acme-prod-1.
Usage telemetry recorded 150.0 staging units under event ev-acme-stg-1.
Contract rule rule-api-rate specifies a rate of 10¢ per unit with an exemption for staging and test environments.
Recalculated amount for line-api-calls is 2500¢, showing a difference of -2500¢.
A verified goodwill adjustment adj-acme-1 of 500¢ was previously applied by the account team.
possible_explanations: Staging environment usage was incorrectly included in the billed quantity by the billing system.
Billed quantity assumed a higher total unit count prior to applying environment exemptions.
open_questions: Should the previously applied goodwill credit of 500¢ be factored into the final refund or adjustment amount?

resolution_options.description: Based on the confirmed calculation discrepancy where staging units were incorrectly billed, recommend issuing a credit for the overcharged amount identified in the billing engine calculation result.
